trendatlas-evolution-worker.service:
# /etc/systemd/system/trendatlas-evolution-worker.service
[Unit]
Description=TrendAtlas frozen causal research worker
Conflicts=mrv1-production.service
After=mrv1-production.service
RefuseManualStart=yes
[Service]
Type=exec
User=trendatlas-research
Group=trendatlas-research
ExecCondition=/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 HOME=/nonexistent OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 /opt/trendatlas-research/venvs/causal-v1/bin/python3 -I -B /opt/trendatlas-research/releases/53b6a5336ca1f7ce35b481a017f7e82396f3613c/research/causal_evolution/bootstrap.py ready
ExecCondition=/usr/bin/python3 -I -B /opt/trendatlas-research/releases/53b6a5336ca1f7ce35b481a017f7e82396f3613c/research/causal_evolution/gate.py
ExecStart=/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 HOME=/nonexistent OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 /opt/trendatlas-research/venvs/causal-v1/bin/python3 -I -B /opt/trendatlas-research/releases/53b6a5336ca1f7ce35b481a017f7e82396f3613c/research/causal_evolution/bootstrap.py run
TimeoutStopSec=2s
RuntimeMaxSec=31min
KillMode=control-group
Restart=no
CPUQuota=20%
CPUWeight=1
PrivateNetwork=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX
IPAddressDeny=any
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/trendatlas-research/causal-v1/cycles
InaccessiblePaths=-/run/credentials -/var/lib/trendatlas-research/continuous -/var/lib/trendatlas-research/jobs
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ProtectProc=invisible
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectClock=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
SystemCallArchitectures=native
UMask=0027
Nice=19
IOSchedulingClass=idle
Slice=trendatlas-causal-research.slice
TasksMax=16
MemoryMax=768M
MemorySwapMax=0
LimitAS=768M
LimitMEMLOCK=768M
InaccessiblePaths=/opt/market_regime_v1 /opt/home_automation /etc/default -/etc/credstore -/etc/credstore.encrypted -/run/user

trendatlas-evolution-dispatch.timer:
# /etc/systemd/system/trendatlas-evolution-dispatch.timer
[Unit]
Description=Admit the next bounded TrendAtlas continuous research cycle

[Timer]
OnBootSec=10min
OnUnitInactiveSec=15min
AccuracySec=1min
RandomizedDelaySec=30s
Unit=trendatlas-evolution-dispatch.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
